findings.claim_text: On November 2, 2026, SemiAnalysis published GDPx, an agentic benchmark of 206 long-horizon tasks across 11 professional domains, and put Claude Opus 5.5 at the top with 12.0. Gemini 4 Carbon followed at 10.9 and GPT-6 Astra at 9.6.
On that view, GPT-6 Astra scores 11.8 against 11.7 for Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Carbon falls from second to fifth [^7,5].
German coverage of the same chart adds Fable 5.1 at $67.16, Sonnet 5.5 at $45.27, GPT-6.1 Sol at $9.80, Grok 4.7 at $16.34, DeepSeek 4.1 Flash at $0.94 and GPT-6 Luna at $0.92 [^6].
findings.contradicting_quote: GPT-6 Astra, meanwhile, is the priciest model on the list at $53.99 per task
